topicName: What is the purpose of the 'persistence.xml' file in JPA?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What is the purpose of the 'persistence.xml' file in JPA?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"The persistence.xml file is a configuration file in Java Persistence API (JPA) that defines persistence units. It specifies the data source, entity classes, and other properties needed to manage the persistence of data in a relational database."}]
